title: Joint bit+complex supplier cannot beat the average of the two p16 invoices (negative result)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

New research package `research/joint-supplier-average-ceiling` (negative result, audit of a changed demand; no κ change, no new supplier).

Before: `research/kappa01-outer-repair` §2 leaves open that a self-contained native word serving both the bit address-interchange endpoint and the complex butterfly-layer endpoint would remove the separate bit endpoint, with scoped limit `κ < s/(1+s)` for its joint saving `s`. The hope behind such a word is that the credits of the two sides add while the common neutral work (idle stages, local small jobs) is paid once.

After: a side-by-side `(rank, role)` ledger of the #4470 complex invoice and the #4814 BIT invoice shows that on the p16 controller every joint ledger that respects the rank-mass identity has saving between the two side roots, at most 0.003232 (+7.0% over the selected 0.00302015), below the BIT gate 0.003475458 (+15.1%) that an ordinary complex-side improvement reaches. The literal "identical (rank, role) paid once" rule removes 74,499 units of paid mass with unchanged targets (identity violated; its 0.18 is not a ceiling); idle ranks 8(j+1) and 7(j+1) never coincide; aligned twins have negative surplus; the only larger variants are the known small-job merge lever, reproduced inside one side alone (0.004109).

What it does: `verify.py` (standard library, 40-digit Decimal) authenticates the four pinned inputs, reproduces both raw roots to 1e-13, checks the surplus identities 752/753, partitions both invoices into roles, computes six joint models, checks the averaging property, binds the quoted outer statements to their source bytes and runs six rejecting controls. Status `negative-result`; selected κ and BIT admission unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Base `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`. Card `joint-query-controller`, scope **changed** (reason in TASK.json): the card asks about the installed QQ16 caller; this package prices a different changed demand, the joint bit+complex supplier. Inputs: `research/joint-helper-lattice/RESULT.json` (#4470), `research/bit-finite-ordinary-bootstrap/RESULT.json` (#4814), `research/kappa01-outer-repair/README.md`, `research/coordinated-frames-and-entrance-banks/arithmetic/balanced_shared.py`.

Nearest overlap: `kappa01-outer-repair` (one side paying for the other through Walsh adapters; the opposite direction of this package), `productive-lever-reprice` (#4602, the lever table whose merge lever E/F reproduces), `admission-constant-derivation` (#4697, the surplus identity used here). Added value: a source-bound ceiling that closes the "one supplier for both" door on the current controller with a seconds-long replay.

## Validation

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/joint-supplier-average-ceiling --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/joint-supplier-average-ceiling
```

Both pass locally on Python 3.12 (Windows): `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`. Controls: broken surplus, wrong recorded BIT surplus, foreign idle rank, swapped targets/paid, literal model as ceiling, tampered source pin (all rejected). Not run: the 47-inequality outer engine with `a = b = s`; the outer admission is cited from `kappa01-outer-repair` §2, not replayed, since the invoice ceiling decides the question. This is a finite check of the moment model on two frozen invoices, not a theorem about every controller.

## Credit

#4470 (zxv lineage), #4814 (ai-nanachi, on PR4760), `kappa01-outer-repair` and the balanced engine (Zhihao Chen, RaD/hipotures, icekylinx, eumemic), `productive-lever-reprice`. Prepared by Mark (Matarener) with substantial Claude (Anthropic) assistance; Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Whether a changed controller can give a two-endpoint word more credits per port window than either side has alone (the ceiling rests on `S_joint ≤ S_c + S_b` on the same windows). First step and blockers in TASK.json and the README.
